<div class="card-body">
'''Utinni!''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ウーティーニー！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分のジャワの1人がウーティーニー・エフェクトと同じ場所にいるなら、そのカードを“盗んで”自分の手札にいれることができる。後は、自分のカードとして使用できる。2：カードの名前に“ジャワ”が含まれるインタラプトかエフェクトを1つ打ち消すことができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-118o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジャワ同士の言葉で、「こっちへ来い！」の意。ジャワは共同で働き、機械装備をあさる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Utinni!

'''Card text:''' Choose one. If one of your Jawas is at the same location as an Utinni Effect, steal that card into hand and use it as your own. Cancel one Interrupt or Effect whose name includes Jawa.

'''Lore:''' Jawa speech meaning “Come here!” Jawas work together and scavenge machines.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Utinni!]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
